title: Invertibility of the ordinary ringed pullback completion map
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l, using the completed coefficients of [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. For a morphism f:X→Y of Noetherian finite-dimensional schemes on which l is a unit in global sections, let pullIso identify the ordinary exact ringed pullback with ordinaryIntegralDerivedPull by equality of their direct coefficient maps and uniqueness of adjoints and total left derived functors. Let pullComparison be pullIso followed by ordinaryIntegralCompletionComparison from [lem-tw-ordinary-completed-integral-pullback]. For every integral constructible K on Y, pullComparison at K is invertible.

source.place: Integral reconstruction; tensor and pullback normalization before forming the proper counit projection

proof.text: The two direct coefficient maps have the same composite with every quotient projection, so uniqueness identifies them. Their module direct images are naturally isomorphic. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies the module pullbacks. The exact ringed pullback makes the ordinary pullback exact, so its exact localization is its total left derived functor. Uniqueness of derived functors constructs pullIso.
The specified ordinary completion comparison is invertible on K by ordinaryCompletedIntegralPullback. Compose with pullIso to get the assertion.

theorem pullComparison_isIso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (hXdim : ∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim X ≤ n)
    (hYdim : ∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim Y ≤ n)
    (hXinv : IsUnit (l : Γ(X, ⊤))) (hYinv : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y) :
    IsIso ((pullComparison l E f).app K.obj)
